processing.geometry: OSM outer relation ways were polygonized, validated, oriented, and emitted as 2D EPSG:4326 GeoJSON.
processing.grid: Native WorldPop 30 arc-second pixels intersecting Gulshan-e-Iqbal were clipped to a 1 cm inward precision buffer of the sourced boundary so PostGIS containment is exact. Population fractions use the original, unbuffered boundary. IDs use immutable raster row/column indices.
processing.population: Boundary-cell people-per-pixel values were multiplied by the EPSG:32642 intersection-area fraction; this assumes population is uniform within each approximately 1 km source pixel.
processing.air_quality: Each CAMS timestep was assigned only to the clipped WorldPop cell containing the provider-returned model coordinate.
processing.landsat: The 2025-09-05 Landsat 9 Collection 2 Level-2 scene was cloud-masked with QA_PIXEL. ST_B10 was scaled to Celsius; red/NIR reflectance was scaled before mean NDVI per project grid.
processing.risk: Chip's committed heat, green, air, flood, mobility, composite, and exposure modules generated only supported per-grid fields. Missing inputs remain null; no area aggregation was inferred.

null.rainfall: IMERG product/version and rainfall processing method remain unresolved.
null.elevation: No approved DEM product/file was available through the implemented clients.
null.slope: Slope requires an approved DEM and method.
null.road_density: OSM road selectors and density definition remain unresolved.
null.green_percentage: NDVI is populated as Chip's approved green-model input; EO4SD classes are not collapsed into this separate field.
